The buzz never left. Bookmark this page for the latest news, rumblings and analysis from ESPN's insiders.</description><pubDate>Fri, 13 Nov 2026 20:06:17 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2025/0121/r1441247_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Sources: Murray wants trade from Pelicans; both sides working on resolution</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50473732/sources-dejounte-murray-wants-trade-pelicans</link><description>Pelicans guard Dejounte Murray wants a trade from the franchise, and his agent, Klutch Sports CEO Rich Paul, and team officials have started working on a resolution, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.</description><pubDate>Fri, 13 Nov 2026 21:09:22 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/0302/r1622171_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Ex-lottery pick Doug McDermott retires after 12 NBA seasons</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50473335/ex-lottery-pick-doug-mcdermott-retires-12-nba-seasons</link><description>Three-point specialist Doug McDermott has retired from the NBA after 12 seasons spent with seven teams.</description><pubDate>Fri, 13 Nov 2026 18:56:01 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1113/r1745362_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Prosecutors: Text shows Rozier, friend planned to bet unders on Hornets teammate</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50472807/terry-rozier-unders-bet-hornets-teammate</link><description>A co-defendant in an NBA betting case told a gambler that he and Terry Rozier were planning a wagering scheme centered on another Hornets player, federal prosecutors alleged in a court filing.</description><pubDate>Fri, 13 Nov 2026 20:01:58 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1113/r1745307_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
